what: Rigor lens on the pre-registered H1/H2/H3 conditioning claims
discipline: Applies the SAME registered +5pp clustered rule, and adds (a) a cluster-bootstrap 95% CI on each amplification and (b) BH-FDR + Bonferroni correction across the three hypotheses tested together.
SAMPLE_DRIFT_WARNING: The pre-registration was run once on 20 events (2026-07-22); the DB now holds 52 events (history loaded back to 1987). The registered scripts recompute on the grown sample, so today's numbers differ from what ENGINE.md documents. Drifted verdicts: ['H2']. This is a scientific-integrity decision for Joe: freeze the registered sample, or re-baseline the study on the expanded N.
honest_note: At N ~ 44 episodes the bootstrap CIs are wide by construction -- a small sample cannot promote a claim to a confident edge. The value here is honesty about uncertainty, and the multiple-testing context: we ran three tests, so a single small p is worth less than it looks.
